stories.title: S. Korea Defeats Japan to Win Fourth Straight Gold Medal in Asiad Football

en.title: S. Korea Defeats Japan to Win Fourth Straight Gold Medal in Asiad Football
en.summary: South Korea's men's football team defeated Japan 1-0 at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, securing its fourth consecutive gold medal in the sport. Midfielder Eom Ji-sung scored the winning goal in the 61st minute.

en.title: PGA Tour winner Kim Joo-hyung captures men's golf gold medal, helps S. Korea win team silver
en.summary: PGA Tour player Kim Joo-hyung won the men's golf gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, finishing at 18-under 262. South Korea secured silver in the team golf event.

en.title: Lee Woo-seok Claims 2nd Archery Gold at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean archer Lee Woo-seok won his second gold medal at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Japan's Junya Nakanishi in the men's individual recurve final.

en.title: S. Korea's Choi Ji-un wins gold in boy's dinghy sailing at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean sailor Choi Ji-un, age 15, won the gold medal in boys' dinghy sailing at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, becoming the youngest gold medalist in the country's delegation.

en.title: Oh Ye-jin wins silver in women's recurve archery at Asian Games
en.summary: South Korean archer Oh Ye-jin claimed the silver medal in women's individual recurve archery at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, finishing second after a shoot-off against India's Kumkum Anil Mohod.

stories.title: Faker celebrates back-to-back Asian Games gold

en.title: Faker celebrates back-to-back Asian Games gold
en.summary: South Korea's League of Legends team, featuring esports player Faker, won gold at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games by defeating Taiwan in the final, securing the country's second consecutive Asian Games title in the game.

stories.title: S. Korea faces Japan again in bid for fourth straight Asian Games soccer gold

en.title: S. Korea faces Japan again in bid for fourth straight Asian Games soccer gold
en.summary: South Korea will play Japan in the Asian Games soccer final on Saturday, with Korea seeking their fourth consecutive gold medal. Korea defeated China 2-1 in the semifinals while Japan beat Uzbekistan on penalties.
